newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen Bank details dividends, unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Bank details dividends, unchanged.

text.p: The Shenzhen Development Bank said on Tuesday it had passed its original 1996 dividend plan unchanged after punishment of the bank for stock-related irregularities had spurred talk of a revision.

The A share market leader would make a five-for-10 bonus issue and a pre-tax cash payout of 0.2 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, the bank said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
Investors had feared the bank would alter its dividend plan after the firm was penalised by Beijing regulators for illegally trading its own shares.
The yuan-based shares would go ex-dividend and ex-right on August 25, the bank said.
Trading in the firm's shares has not been suspended despite the announcement.
